en: All we now have to do is make sure that we
return a response with that new list item
that should be added to this list here.
And to create such a list item, we can use
this renderLocation function, which is
provided by that location.js file, which
produces such a list item.
And we'll have to make sure that we then
send different requests depending on where
the item is rendered, but for the moment, we
can ignore that.
So in App.js,
down here in the POST route where I send
back a response, I can send back a list item
by calling renderLocation.
And then renderLocation needs such a
location object, which I conveniently have
here though.
I extracted it by its ID from the
availableLocations array.
So therefore it's this location which I can
pass to renderLocation and with that, this
POST route will return such a list item.
And with that back in our HTML code, we can
make sure that the response of this request
is then rendered in the right place on this
page.
And the right place to render it is of
course this interesting places list here,
this interesting locations list, I should
say.
Conveniently, this list has an ID of
interesting locations.
So we can use that to target this list.
And therefore here in location.js,
we can set the hx-target to
#interesting-locations
and then make sure that the list item that's
received in the response of this POST
request is added to the end of this list
by adding hx-swap.
And setting this to before
end.
We could actually also set it to after begin
here as an alternative and to mix things up
to make sure that it's added at the
beginning of this list. But here I'll use
before
end to add it at the end.
Well, and with all that done, if you save
everything and you have that development
server up and running,
If you reload your
app and you click on an item, it should be
added here.
Now at the moment, if you then click it
again, it's added again because we have the
same attributes on that button in that list
item no matter where it's being rendered. So
we'll have to fix that.
But the general functionality is there as
you can tell, and that's great.
